description: This file defines a Java interface 'ExistsFieldExpression' used for creating query filters based on field existence within the Eclipse Ditto project. It declares methods for visitor pattern evaluation but contains no implementation or additional logic.

classes.name: ExistsFieldExpression
classes.description: A Java interface representing an expression to check for the existence of a field in a query filter, utilizing the visitor pattern for evaluation.

methods.name: acceptExistsVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor that performs evaluation of the exists field expression, returning a result of type T.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a general field expression visitor to perform some operation based on the expression.
